'''Delaya''' was the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Alderaan (star)|Alderaan]] in the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]].
It was the sister world of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] before the latter's [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].

==Description==
Delaya was so close to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] that it was clearly visible in Alderaan's sky. Alderaan outsourced much of its industry to Delaya, creating a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a large population and many urban areas filled with factories and warehouses as well as homes. Delaya's busy economy attracted workers from many [[Species/Legends|species]], including [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]], [[Ryn/Legends|Ryn]], and [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. After the destruction of Alderaan, Delaya was the only planet in the system that supported life. It was significantly smaller than Alderaan.

==History==
[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]] was responsible for passing laws that facilitated trade between the two planets in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

[[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] was inspecting a new [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] transmission station in a far [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around Delaya when Alderaan was destroyed. Delaya served as an evacuation site for some of the few who escaped Alderaan before its destruction.<ref name="GG3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref>

When [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] visited Delaya to formally mourn her homeworld along with the refugees from it as well as to gather support for the Rebel Alliance, she encountered the former Jedi [[Ferus Olin]], as well as a group of Alderaanians who tried to turn her in to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="RFH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Delaya in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]], which is actually located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].
